reference: Couples who get married: Phyllis and Bob Vance (S3E15), Jim and Pam (wedding weekend in Niagara Falls, S6E4), Angela and Senator Robert Lipton (engaged S7E24; referred to as husband and wife from S8E1, wedding offscreen), Roy and Laura (Roy's wedding, S9E2), and Dwight and Angela (S9E23). Short-lived or unverified: Ryan and Kelly (an impulsive chapel marriage that is annulled/divorced within a week, S7E14), Michael and Holly (engaged S7E18, but a wedding is not shown or stated in the transcripts).

evidence.line: Michael: Phyllis is getting married. And I am in the wedding party.
Michael: It's your wedding. And you're nervous...
Bob Vance: Mind if I steal my wife?
Penny: [music starts playing and people start dancing down the isle] I begged them not to. (the Jim/Pam wedding procession)
Jim: I bought those boat tickets the day I saw that You Tube video... The boat was actually Plan C. The church was Plan B and Plan A was marrying her a long, long time ago.
Angela: Pam, you know how you and Jim did your ironic wedding? Pam: That was our dream wedding.
Angela: I am having a child with my husband, the Senator.
Angela: it's my husband's favorite cat... the only time I've seen him cry other than our wedding night.
Jim: We are going to Roy's wedding.
Roy: If it wasn't for you, I never would've met Laura.
Minister: I now pronounce you man and wife. [everyone cheers]
Kelly: Over the weekend, Ryan Bailey Howard and I got divorced. ... Andy: Sorry, when did you get married? Kelly: Ummm, like a week ago, we got really wasted and it just felt right.

list_items.item: Ryan and Kelly (impulsive marriage, divorced within a week)
Michael and Holly (not shown or stated as married in the transcripts)

caveats: Core = weddings/marriages of main-cast couples that the transcripts support: Phyllis-Bob, Jim-Pam, Dwight-Angela, Angela-Robert (wedding itself offscreen, but husband/wife and 'wedding night' are stated). Optional: Roy-Laura (a minor, side-character wedding; only the wedding and name Laura are stated), Ryan-Kelly (legally a marriage by the characters' account, but a joke-like, week-long episode; I would credit it but not require it), Michael-Holly (the transcripts show only the engagement and the move to Colorado; any later wedding is not in the data, so an answer including it from memory cannot be checked, and an answer omitting it is fine). Not weddings: Dwight/Andy/Angela mock ceremony rehearsal at Schrute Farms (S5E9 sc.18), the cancelled Pam-Roy wedding (S3E1 sc.24), and Michael's 'I'm getting married' joke (S5E6 sc.3). The Jim-Pam secret Niagara boat ceremony is visual; the transcripts show the wedding weekend and S7E24 'ironic wedding'. Fan transcripts miss visual details.
question: Which couples get married over the series?
